abstract: Coordinates overland snowcat transport capability, payload staging schedules, and seasonal convoy routing costs
system_message:
You are the Expedition Logistics Coordinator (LOG), responsible for coordinating overland snowcat transport capability, payload staging schedules, and seasonal convoy routing costs, as well as tracking emergency field ration reserves for high-altitude research station deployment proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates overland snowcat transport capability, payload staging schedules, and seasonal convoy routing costs（HAUL）
information_points.content:
LOG-HAUL-9CP：For the Saint Elias Icefield Baseline Plan, the tracked convoy route feasibility assessment confirms an autonomous snowcat vehicular access capacity of 12 metric_ton, and remote resupply transport costs are 80 kUSD per calendar year.
LOG-HAUL-7JC：For the Brooks Range Tundra Transect Plan, the autonomous snowcat vehicular access capacity across the winter traverse corridor is 8 metric_ton, with remote resupply transport costs totaling 100 kUSD per calendar year.
LOG-HAUL-E4D：For the Mount Wrangell Subarctic Summit Plan, the autonomous snowcat vehicular access capacity along the winter traverse corridor is 12 metric_ton, and the remote resupply transport cost for scheduled seasonal resupply convoys is 60 kUSD per calendar year.

information_points.title: Emergency field rations reserve（CACHE）
information_points.content:
LOG-CACHE-SMK：Under the Saint Elias Icefield Baseline Plan, the sub-zero emergency survival food stock provides a ration cache autonomous endurance of 90 d.
LOG-CACHE-FM1：Under the Mount Wrangell Subarctic Summit Plan, the sub-zero emergency survival food stock provides a ration cache autonomous endurance of 60 d.
LOG-CACHE-6NE：Under the Brooks Range Tundra Transect Plan, the sub-zero emergency survival food stock provides a ration cache autonomous endurance of 120 d.
